title: Bryophyllum pinnatum Induces p53-Dependent Apoptosis of Colorectal Cancer Cells via Increased Intracellular ROS and G2/M Cell-Cycle Arrest In Vitro and Validated in Silico by Molecular Docking.
authors: Mukherjee, Sumoyee; Banik, Sheuli Kangsa; Chakraborty, Sourio; Das, Tanya; Choudhury, Manabendra Dutta; Tripathi, Anusri
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物提取物诱导结直肠癌细胞凋亡，分子对接仅涉及小分子-蛋白结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Chemotherapy, radiotherapy and surgical treatments of cancer having several limitations and toxic side-effects, have led researchers to focus towards development of alternative natural plant-based therapeutics that can reduce disease severity. The present research work is mainly focussed towards identifying molecular mechanisms of apoptosis of colorectal cancer cells (HCT116) by perennial herb Bryophyllum pinnatum leaf-extract via both in vitro experimentations and in silico analysis. B. pinnatum leaf extract induced highest cytotoxicity at lowest dose (IC(50):0.01 mg/mL) against HCT116 cells with 49.5% (p < 0.0001) cellular death, in comparison to other cancer cell lines. It has arrested HCT116 cell populations at G2/M cell-cycle phase and led to 10 folds (p < 0.0001) and 5.5 folds (p < 0.0001) increased intracellular ROS production in treated groups. ROS production might have led to significant 34.23% and 21.03% (p < 0.0001) apoptosis in treated cells, proved in vitro and in silico, with significant upregulation of p53 (p < 0.0001), BAX (p = 0.0252), CASPASE3 (p < 0.0001) and downregulation of BCL2 (p = 0.0058), leading to increased nuclear p53 (p = 0.0002) accumulation in treated cells, suggesting that the leaf-extract might have induced p53-dependent apoptosis of colorectal cancer cells. The phyto-extract also possess significant gene-modulatory potential as evident from qRT-PCR analysis of oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes. Leaf's bioactive phyto-constituents were elucidated by GC-MS and HPLC-ESI/MS analysis. In silico STITCH analysis provided significant network interactions between these bioactive phyto-compounds and studied proteins. Further Molecular Docking studies revealed strong binding between such docked complexes. Also, predicted major bioactive phyto-constituents of B. pinnatum leaf-extract such as Quercetin, Morin and beta-Sitosterol have induced significant (p < 0.0001) apoptosis and increased intracellular ROS, validating their in silico interactions with studied proteins of HCT116 cells. All these studies together demonstrated ability of B. pinnatum to be used as a suitable natural phyto-therapeutic agent for development of chemo-preventive medications against colorectal cancer.
abstract_zh: 癌症的化疗、放疗和手术治疗存在多种局限性和毒副作用，这促使研究者致力于开发能够减轻疾病严重程度的天然植物基替代疗法。本研究主要聚焦于通过体外实验和计算机模拟分析，探讨多年生草本植物落地生根（Bryophyllum pinnatum）叶提取物对结直肠癌细胞（HCT116）凋亡的分子机制。与其他癌细胞系相比，B. pinnatum叶提取物在最低剂量（IC(50)：0.01 mg/mL）下对HCT116细胞诱导了最高的细胞毒性，导致49.5%（p < 0.0001）的细胞死亡。该提取物将HCT116细胞群体阻滞在G2/M细胞周期阶段，并在处理组中导致细胞内ROS产生增加10倍（p < 0.0001）和5.5倍（p < 0.0001）。ROS的产生可能导致了处理细胞中显著的34.23%和21.03%（p < 0.0001）凋亡，这在体外和计算机模拟中均得到证实，同时伴随p53（p < 0.0001）、BAX（p = 0.0252）、CASPASE3（p < 0.0001）的显著上调和BCL2（p = 0.0058）的下调，导致处理细胞中核p53（p = 0.0002）积累增加，表明叶提取物可能诱导了结直肠癌细胞的p53依赖性凋亡。该植物提取物还具备显著的基因调控潜力，这从癌基因和肿瘤抑制基因的qRT-PCR分析中得以体现。通过GC-MS和HPLC-ESI/MS分析阐明了叶片中的生物活性植物成分。计算机模拟STITCH分析提供了这些生物活性植物化合物与所研究蛋白质之间的显著网络相互作用。进一步的分子对接（Molecular Docking）研究揭示了这些对接复合物之间的强结合。此外，预测的B. pinnatum叶提取物主要生物活性植物成分，如槲皮素（Quercetin）、桑色素（Morin）和β-谷甾醇（beta-Sitosterol），诱导了显著的（p < 0.0001）凋亡并增加了细胞内ROS，验证了它们与HCT116细胞所研究蛋白质的计算机模拟相互作用。所有这些研究共同证明了B. pinnatum作为开发针对结直肠癌的化学预防药物的合适天然植物治疗剂的潜力。
